title: InventorLoader current readiness and generated ACIS semantic gate
mode: Primary-source repository, documentation, and issue-state review; plan refinement only
scope: Refresh the already-screened InventorLoader SAT/SAB parser candidate against current primary sources and open issue reports.
Separate stock FreeCAD DXF import, optional InventorLoader import, direct ACIS parsing, STEP conversion, DWG AcDs association, carrier preservation, and geometric semantics.
Make the existing PAR-07/S8 optional semantic checkpoint implementation-ready using generated controls, while retaining the untrusted-input and external-qualification gates.

sources.observed: The guide distinguishes the built-in C++ and legacy Python DXF importers and states that stock FreeCAD cannot read ACIS/SAT blobs used for DXF 3D solids. Its DWG route converts to DXF before invoking a selected importer.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Route documentation, not runtime qualification. Stock FreeCAD ACIS behavior is not a semantic result for libdxfrw's carrier path; ACIS should be CONSUMER_NOT_APPLICABLE for this stock route unless a future importer changes the contract.

sources.project: InventorLoader repository, parser source, license, and FreeCAD Addon Catalog
sources.revision: Mutable master/catalog pages reviewed 2026-10-20; no repository commit SHA was pinned for execution.
sources.observed: The README advertises SAT/SAB and DXF 3D-solid import and says Released 1.5, while package.xml identifies 1.5.1. Acis.py implements a distinct parser and uses FreeCAD Part. The repository LICENSE identifies GPL-2.0, while prior FreeCAD Addon Report metadata identified LGPL-3.0-or-later, so license provenance is unresolved. The current Addon Catalog points to mutable master, while the GitHub Releases page contains no release artifacts.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Candidate discovery only. The route shares FreeCAD/OCCT geometry infrastructure, does not parse the DWG container or AcDs key associations, and is not a pinned release artifact or independent kernel result. Resolve license/provenance before source reuse or bundling.

sources.project: InventorLoader issue #102: reported SAB import TypeError
sources.revision: Issue page reviewed 2026-10-20; still open in the reviewed page state.
sources.observed: The report says an attached CONTENT_3D model fails conversion with a TypeError involving an integer where a string was expected.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A profile-specific unresolved peer report, not proof that all SAB inputs fail or a local libdxfrw defect. The attachment was not downloaded.

sources.project: InventorLoader issue #103: reported SAT shell construction failure
sources.revision: Issue page reviewed 2026-10-20; still open in the reviewed page state.
sources.observed: The report says a simple attached model fails because no face is recognized and a shell cannot be created.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A profile-specific unresolved peer report. The attachment was not downloaded, and the issue does not establish failure of every current source revision.

sources.project: InventorLoader issue #110: SAT reader workaround and STEP route
sources.revision: Issue page reviewed 2026-10-20; still open in the reviewed page state.
sources.observed: The user reports that Dice.sat initially did not import; the provided macro calls setReader() after AcisReader.readText(), then resolves nodes and exports through STEP before loading into FreeCAD Part. The report says direct native import had messy face normals.
sources.evidenceCeiling: User workaround, not a maintainer release or an unmodified-route pass. Parser, native geometry reconstruction, and STEP conversion must be scored as separate profiles.

sources.project: LibreDWG issue #1411 and ezdxf ACIS API
sources.observed: LibreDWG #1411 includes a from-scratch unit-cube REGION/SAB recipe and reports a 5,489-byte SAB payload, alongside a LibreDWG conversion that loses the modern AcDs/SAB carrier. ezdxf documents a partial ACIS entity model with some classes explicitly not implemented.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A practical generated-control lead and peer failure shape, not a DWG/DXF format authority or general geometry oracle. Do not use LibreDWG dxf2dwg as the positive producer for modern AcDs preservation.

sources.project: Existing pinned from-scratch AC1032/SAB producer recipe
sources.revision: Existing plan recipe identifies ezdxf 1.4.5 and the CPython 3.12 macOS ARM64 wheel SHA-256 e78a6b6aaac31f915026694f669cb3172636380caad9ec41007636f034013106; no artifact was acquired or run in this pass.
sources.observed: The already-planned candidate creates two AC1032/SAB 3DSOLID bodies from independently authored asymmetric rectangular prisms and an analytic metric manifest. This is more implementation-ready and less redundant than adding a new unit-cube route; it remains conditional on an isolated probe of the exact artifact and runtime profile.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A plan-level scratch producer candidate only. It has not executed here, does not establish AC1024/SAT support, and is not a version-format authority or semantic result.

sources.observed: Prior plan research already identified InventorLoader's FreeCAD/OCCT lineage, an unrestricted Python eval path requiring safety review, shell/face fallback, and unsupported ACIS feature classes.
sources.evidenceCeiling: This refresh does not clear those limitations. It adds current issue/release freshness and a narrow generated semantic-control recipe only.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: retain InventorLoader as SCREENED_NOT_ADMITTED until a source commit/hash, current license/dependency closure, safety audit, and unmodified exact-profile run are available.
PAR-07/S8: do not count optional InventorLoader as stock FreeCAD import, DWG/AcDs parser, independent kernel, or general ACIS support; separate direct parser and STEP-conversion routes.
PAR-07/S8: reuse the already-scoped generated AC1032/SAB two-asymmetric-prism recipe and authored analytic manifest; do not add a duplicate cube profile or infer AC1024/SAT support.

Validation policy: make the optional peer route a one-time composed checkpoint, keep generated controls temporary, and self-unblock to local bounded implementation work when the external route is unavailable.
assessment.planImpact: Do not use current FreeCAD stock DXF import as an ACIS semantic oracle. Keep InventorLoader optional and not admitted until its mutable source is pinned and its safety and route-specific failures are resolved. If a future composed checkpoint admits it, reuse the existing AC1032/SAB two-asymmetric-prism scratch recipe and analytic manifest, and separate the direct parser, STEP route, carrier bytes, DWG AcDs association, kernel output, and stock/application import outcomes. No new support claim or J transition is justified.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research and plan/receipt update
method.limitations: GitHub issue reports, project README, package metadata, Addon Catalog, and documentation are mutable. No InventorLoader commit was pinned or executed. The reported issues are profile-specific and do not prove all current inputs fail. The existing ezdxf scratch producer recipe is only a candidate and was not executed here; it does not establish AC1024/SAT support or authoritative ACIS/DWG format behavior. Earlier source review's eval/fallback/unsupported-class limitations remain open.
